_about: Versioned trend memory (owner, 28 Nov). Every entry is a creative MECHANISM, not a motif to copy. 'evidence.verified' is true only when the owner (or a permitted source) confirmed the trend on TikTok Creative Center / Instagram — never invented. Entries expire; expired ones are ignored. Add verified trends by hand.
